## Overview Align the authoritative Kimi-K3 MI355X AgentX guide with [InferenceX #4393](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4393), replacing the previous [#4215 alignment](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62273). This updates only `recipes/models/moonshotai/Kimi-K3.yaml`. ## Claims - All ten documented lanes use TP8/DCP8/A2A and fused KDA prefill on `nightly-rocm100-df6603f0583375f244d1ac6d36265462b7490392`. - Only resident c1 enables `latency_specialized` and V2, without target online FP8 quantization or a KV connector; other lanes retain their source quantization/offload settings. - An explicit resident/offload selector distinguishes the two c4 lanes. Production/eval commands use real block verification; synthetic acceptance remains in a separate throughput-only section. ## Validation Passed locally against recipes renderer `f7e8b4ac02716ffd5938c9c3a594960d314cdc2f` (`VLLM_CHECKOUT` is the tested vLLM checkout): ```bash pre-commit run --files recipes/models/moonshotai/Kimi-K3.yaml # In the recipes renderer checkout, with a local vllm source override: node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir "$VLLM_CHECKOUT/recipes" node scripts/sync-sources.mjs node scripts/build-recipes-api.mjs pnpm test:overlay pnpm test:schema pnpm test:guide-html ``` Actual synthesis of 16 MI355X TP8/Python feature/offload combinations produced identical Serve, Docker, Verify and Bench commands before/after. The local browser rendered the ten-row guide and separate production/synthetic blocks; MI355X/Python/speculative decoding/DCP/Simple selectors worked without JavaScript errors. The fresh preview lacked provider-logo assets (404s only under `/providers/`). The source validator/API build covered 217 recipes; overlay/schema/guide checks passed 7/4/17 tests. Executed the guide's actual Bash with a stub `vllm` for every lane and compared arguments, JSON and environment against InferenceX's real recipe binder: **10/10 match**, including draft lengths, graph captures, target quantization and connector settings. Unsupported selectors (resident c2, offload c1, unknown profile) exit before invocation; `bash -n` passes.
InferenceX runtime qualification evidence [InferenceX run 40037005947, attempt 2](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40037005947/attempts/2) passed all ten performance cells and its accuracy jobs. Representative direct evidence: [resident c1 performance](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40037005947/job/120818810674), [resident c4 performance](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40037005947/job/120818811293), [offload c4 performance](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40037005947/job/120818811543), [offload c60 performance](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40037005947/job/120818810516), [c1 eval](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40037005947/job/120818811565), [c4 eval](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40037005947/job/120818810663), [c60 evals](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40037005947/job/120818811692) / [second job](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40037005947/job/120818812013). That run used source `0df7e892b73c53d66a486c2a085e994b67653042`; the Kimi serving recipe, selected matrix, model and image match audited head [`dee7824`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/tree/dee7824e8ca3810cc36fe668ed75a927183af41f). This is source compatibility evidence, not an exact-head rerun. Accuracy jobs are deduplicated by [evaluation identity](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/dee7824e8ca3810cc36fe668ed75a927183af41f/inferencex-e2e/infx/evals/EVALS.md#L33); there is no separate eval for each offload cell. No local GPU serving/eval was run, and no new performance gain is claimed.
Upstream [Recipes / Validate](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/actions/runs/40144071812/job/121021593346) and [DCO](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/runs/121021590656) passed. Hosted pre-commit was skipped after the [eligibility check](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/actions/runs/40144113322/job/121021720567) found 2 merged PRs (requires 4 or a maintainer label); local pre-commit passed as listed above. ## Details The specialized backend's [#60683](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60683) constraints are scoped to the pinned runtime. These settings depend on the concurrency/profile, so they stay in the reproduction guide; generic builder configuration and the rolling image remain unchanged. Open/merged PR searches for Kimi-K3 recipes, `4393`, and `latency_specialized` found no duplicate. [#62668](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62668) concerns Ascend; [#63409](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63409) fixes a DCP1 engine path and does not update this DCP8 recipe. AI assistance: Codex prepared the change and validation. Submitted as a draft for human review; this does not assert that the submitter has already completed personal line-by-line review or GPU validation. ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

@@ -67,7 +67,7 @@ features:
       # MI355X serves the InferenceX AgentX lane's draft (see the guide's MI355X

       # vllm-project/vllm#55966, and the draft's FP8 KV assumes an FP8 target KV.
-      # 7 draft tokens is the lane's dcp1 value (concurrency 1 and 4), not a universal value.
+      # 7 draft tokens is the lane's GPU-resident c1/c4 value, not a universal value.
       mi355x:
         args:
           - "--kv-cache-dtype"
@@ -1092,58 +1092,60 @@ guide: |
 
   ## AMD MI355X: InferenceX AgentX alignment
 
-  The MI355X single-node TP8 command follows the [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) agentic-coding (AgentX) lane `kimik3-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-mtp` as of [InferenceX PR #4215](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4215) at branch revision [`6e72cbc`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/tree/6e72cbc11234e624d66b8fc5eaddac50068db15c): the entry in [`configs/amd-master.yaml`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/6e72cbc11234e624d66b8fc5eaddac50068db15c/inferencex-e2e/configs/amd-master.yaml) and its [lane recipe](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/6e72cbc11234e624d66b8fc5eaddac50068db15c/inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/kimik3/vllm/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml). The lane is a benchmark configuration: text-only, TP8 on one MI355X node, with the tool-call and reasoning parsers on.
+  The single-node MI355X TP8 AgentX configuration follows [InferenceX #4393](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4393): its [master entry](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/dee7824e8ca3810cc36fe668ed75a927183af41f/inferencex-e2e/configs/amd-master.yaml#L766) and [lane recipe](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/dee7824e8ca3810cc36fe668ed75a927183af41f/inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/kimik3/vllm/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml) at `dee7824`. It serves text with tool-call and reasoning parsers, using DCP8/A2A at every point. There is no concurrency-2 point.
 
   **In the command builder.** Settings the lane uses at every concurrency are part of the MI355X TP8 command: `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9`, `--max-model-len 1048576`, `--enable-prefix-caching`, `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, `--attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"ROCM_AITER_FA"}'`, `--stream-interval 10`, `VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MLA_ASM_PADDING=asm`, `VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MLA_DCP_VERIFY=asm` and `AITER_FLYDSL_STAGE2_FP8=1`. Weights load with vLLM's default loader (the AMD profile's `--load-format auto`): with `fastsafetensors`, the lane's servers ran out of GPU memory while loading weights on its image. The lane's `--moe-backend auto` is vLLM's default selection, so the builder leaves that flag unset. Other AMD GPUs keep the general AMD profile.
 
   - **Spec decoding** serves the lane's draft, the published [`Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark`](https://huggingface.co/Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark), with its attention on `ROCM_AITER_MLA` ([vllm-project/vllm#55966](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55966)), FP8 KV, probabilistic drafting and block verification. Draft length is tuned per cell in the matrix below.
-  - **Target quantization** is online FP8 per-channel and differs by cell, so it stays in the guide: concurrency 1 applies `linear: fp8_per_channel` with the ignored-layer list in the command below, and every other cell quantizes only the KDA `in_proj_qkvgfab` projections. The routed experts remain MXFP4. The DSpark draft keeps its BF16 weights and activations with FP8 KV: vLLM builds the named draft from its own unquantized config, so `--quantization-config` reaches only the target.
+  - **Target quantization** stays in the guide: resident c1 passes no online quantization config, preserving the BF16 target weights required by specialized decode. Every other cell quantizes only the KDA `in_proj_qkvgfab` projections to FP8 per-channel. Routed experts retain their native MXFP4 weights. The DSpark draft remains BF16 with FP8 KV: vLLM builds the named draft from its own unquantized config, so removing c1's target quantization does not change the draft's dtype.
   - **Decode context parallelism** emits the lane's DCP8 pairing: `--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_MLA`, `--dcp-comm-backend a2a`, `ROCM_AITER_FA` prefill and the direct DCP ops off.
   - The **Simple** KV-offload option emits the connector the lane uses (`SimpleCPUOffloadConnector`, `kv_both`, `lazy_offload: false`).
   - Select **Python** in the frontend selector to match the lane, which runs vLLM's default frontend.
 
   **Per-concurrency tuning (guide only).** The lane runs the following ten cells. The builder keeps general values (`--max-num-seqs 128`, `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`, and effective `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` CUDA graphs); use the reproduction command below for exact benchmark cells. Every cell requests `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` with breakable CUDA graphs disabled (`VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=0`); because Kimi-K3 has no `torch.compile` submodule, vLLM resolves that mode to `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` at load.
 
-  | Concurrency | DCP | KV offload | Draft tokens | `--max-num-seqs` | `--max-num-batched-tokens` | Largest CUDA graph | Target quantization |
+  Every cell adds `kda_prefill_backend: fused` in `--additional-config`. Only **resident c1** also sets `decode_backend: latency_specialized` and `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`. On the pinned image, this [MI355X specialized path](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60683) requires TP8, V2, gfx950, no KV connector and BF16 target projections. It handles pure speculative-verification batches of at most eight rows (c1 with K7); other steps use the normal layers. These lane-specific settings stay out of generic MI355X defaults.
+
+  | Concurrency | DCP | Profile | Draft tokens | `--max-num-seqs` | `--max-num-batched-tokens` | Largest CUDA graph | Target online quantization |
   | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
-  | 1 | 1 | none | 7 | 1 | 16384 | 16 | `linear` |
-  | 4 | 1 | none | 7 | 8 | 8192 | 64 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
-  | 4 | 8 | Simple | 5 | 8 | 8192 | 48 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
-  | 10 | 8 | Simple | 4 | 20 | 8192 | 100 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
-  | 16 | 8 | Simple | 4 | 32 | 8192 | 160 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
-  | 24 | 8 | Simple | 4 | 48 | 8192 | 240 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
-  | 32 | 8 | Simple | 4 | 64 | 8192 | 320 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
-  | 48 | 8 | Simple | 4 | 96 | 8192 | 480 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
-  | 52 | 8 | Simple | 4 | 104 | 8192 | 520 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
-  | 60 | 8 | Simple | 4 | 120 | 8192 | 600 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
+  | 1 | 8 | resident | 7 | 1 | 16384 | 16 | none |
+  | 4 | 8 | resident | 7 | 8 | 8192 | 64 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
+  | 4 | 8 | offload | 5 | 8 | 8192 | 48 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
+  | 10 | 8 | offload | 4 | 20 | 8192 | 100 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
+  | 16 | 8 | offload | 4 | 32 | 8192 | 160 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
+  | 24 | 8 | offload | 4 | 48 | 8192 | 240 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
+  | 32 | 8 | offload | 4 | 64 | 8192 | 320 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
+  | 48 | 8 | offload | 4 | 96 | 8192 | 480 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
+  | 52 | 8 | offload | 4 | 104 | 8192 | 520 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
+  | 60 | 8 | offload | 4 | 120 | 8192 | 600 | `in_proj_qkvgfab` |
 
-  DCP8 shards the decode KV read across all eight GPUs and uses the A2A backend. Simple offload cells use 224.875 GB of host DRAM per rank. `--max-num-seqs` is twice the concurrency, except that concurrency 1 admits one sequence. Every cell captures every even CUDA-graph size from 2 through `2 × concurrency × (1 + draft tokens)`. Agentic benchmark runs replace block rejection with the golden acceptance length for every draft length; synthetic acceptance is not suitable for serving or accuracy evaluation.
+  The `resident` profile keeps KV on GPU; `offload` uses `SimpleCPUOffloadConnector` with 224.875 GB of host DRAM per rank. `--max-num-seqs` is twice the concurrency, except that concurrency 1 admits one sequence. Every cell captures every even CUDA-graph size from 2 through `2 × concurrency × (1 + draft tokens)`. Agentic benchmark runs replace block rejection with the golden acceptance length; synthetic acceptance is not suitable for serving or accuracy evaluation.
 
-  **Image.** The MI355X default variant uses `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100`, the rolling ROCm 10.0 nightly. InferenceX PR #4215 pins `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-49cb2bbf71cfd36ee5aa33d1e184b1cddff55294` (vLLM `49cb2bbf`). This path needs [vllm-project/vllm#53940](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53940) (SiTUv2 a4w4 MoE routing) and #55966.
+  **Image.** The builder keeps the rolling `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100` image. Run the exact commands below inside `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-df6603f0583375f244d1ac6d36265462b7490392` (vLLM `df6603f0`), the image qualified by #4393 and carrying #60683. The compatibility limits above refer to this pinned runtime.
 
   **MoE environment.** The lane sets `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_SITUV2=1`, as the AMD profile does, plus `AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND=0` and `AITER_FLYDSL_STAGE2_FP8=1`. The SiTUv2 path does not read `AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND`. `AITER_FLYDSL_STAGE2_FP8=1` makes the FlyDSL MoE down projection write its per-route outputs as MXFP8 (FP8 values with E8M0 scales) instead of BF16 before they are summed. It affects only the target's MoE layers; the DSpark draft's MLP is dense.
 
   **QuickReduce.** The lane also enables INT4 QuickReduce (`VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4`) with `VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_MIN_SIZE_BYTES_MB=16`, so only tensor-parallel all-reduces of 16 MiB or more use the INT4 codec. INT4 all-reduce is lossy, so it is not in the builder. The DSpark draft's all-reduces carry only its draft-step tokens (at most 600 tokens × 7,168 BF16 values, about 8.2 MiB, at concurrency 60), and its context projection has no all-reduce, so the 16 MiB floor keeps the draft out of the INT4 path in every lane cell.
 
   ### Reproducing one lane cell
 
-  This is the real-verification form, the one InferenceX's eval jobs use and the one to use for any serving:
+  Run each cell in a fresh shell inside the pinned image. This real-verification form is for serving and accuracy evaluation; `PROFILE` distinguishes the two concurrency-4/DCP8 cells:
 
   ```bash
-  # One lane cell per server. For CONC=4, choose DCP=1 or DCP=8.
-  CONC=1
-  DCP=1
-  case "$CONC:$DCP" in
-    1:1) K=7; BATCHED=16384; OFFLOAD=0 ;;
-    4:1) K=7; BATCHED=8192; OFFLOAD=0 ;;
-    4:8) K=5; BATCHED=8192; OFFLOAD=1 ;;
-    10:8|16:8|24:8|32:8|48:8|52:8|60:8) K=4; BATCHED=8192; OFFLOAD=1 ;;
-    *) echo "CONC=$CONC DCP=$DCP is not a lane cell" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  PROFILE=resident
+  CLIENTS=1
+  case "$PROFILE:$CLIENTS" in
